[← Portfolio](portfolio.ipynb)

Autocode gives the headless agent harness a browser interface and a durable place to
inspect its work. A user can create a session, send a task, follow events as they
arrive, and return to the same timeline after refreshing the page.

## What it contains

The application combines a semantic HTML and JavaScript frontend with FastAPI REST
routes and a WebSocket event stream. A shared application service supports both the
web and command-line interfaces. An append-only journal records events, while a
SQLite projection makes sessions queryable. The project also includes artifacts,
search, sync, replay, background jobs, and update and operations paths.

The default runner is deterministic, so the complete request and event flow can be
tried locally without an API key. A live agent-harness adapter is available when a
provider is configured.

## Explore the project

- [Source code and setup](https://github.com/particle1331/watchtower/tree/main/projects/autocode)
- [Shipping the Agent course](../courses/autocode/index.ipynb)

The local implementation is the demonstrated path. PostgreSQL, S3-compatible
storage, managed identity, and a reverse proxy are separate production adapters.
